title: NLLCORE
description: Explore a surreal dimension of digital anomalies with world-bending tools, chaotic biomes, and experimental glitch mechanics
body:
### Overview

Nullcore is an experimental mod centered around the themes of digital anomalies, errors, and surreal **glitch** aesthetics. It pushes the boundaries of standard gameplay by introducing chaotic mechanics and unstable environments

## Features
- **The Null Dimension**: A surreal realm with chaotic biome blending. To enter, you need to build a portal using bedrock blocks
- **Anomalous Tools & Weapons**: Includes items like the Null Creatrix, which allows you to manipulate world properties and entity states in creative ways
- **Glitch Items**: New food types that grant powerful effects, and armor sets that provide unique interactions with the environment
- **Experimental Mechanics**: Unique blocks that assimilate surrounding structures

## Important Note
This is an **experimental** project. While designed to be chaotic, it is recommended to back up your worlds


### About
> I made this mod on July 15th, 2025
